verdict.rationale: Hummingbird documents its own approval workflow: cases are submitted for approval, approvers are added within a review, peer approvals are a workflow configuration, and workflows can be set up to mirror policy (docs-18, 19, 20). It also files to FinCEN with tracking (docs-5, 10, 11). However, no evidence states that FinCEN filing is blocked until an authorized approver signs off. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that approval gates external submission, role-based restriction of who may approve, a record of approvals in the audit trail tied to filings, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
